title: 打开一条小缝
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve existing named identities, not just species. Input 1: canonical identity reference for 皮皮 (pipi); preserve this character exactly. Input 2: Pipi clothing sheet only; follow the exact outfit specified below. Input 3: visual continuity reference.
Visible characters: 皮皮 (pipi). Exact total number of visible characters: 1. Do not draw extra background animals. Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 皮皮 1.0. Pipi wears ONLY the LEFT daytime outfit from the wardrobe sheet: dusty blue overalls, oatmeal shirt, blue cloth shoes, small yellow backpack. No star cap in daytime. Scene continuity: 同一卧室近景，床边小桌。
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 皮皮用爪子把盒盖轻轻掀开一条窄缝，凑近倾听。
Emotional performance for this exact beat: 眼睛睁大一点，期待里有轻微疑惑。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 同一木盒、尚无红叶，无可见声音符号。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events. Continuity-specific locks: Do not depict sound as visible letters, music notes, sound waves, glowing objects, or captured material. Reference roles: Input 1 is the canonical identity reference for pipi; preserve this exact character. Input 2 shows Pipi's day and sleep outfits; use only the outfit specified in the prompt. Input 3: This is the same single pale honey-pine lidded box; preserve its rounded corners and small scale.Light and time lock: This exact scene occurs at night in the bedroom. Show a dark blue night sky outside the window, warm interior lamplight and no daylight. Strong time and continuity lock: nighttime bedroom, deep blue starry sky outside, warm bedside lamp. Pipi is still in his day outfit but indoors without his yellow backpack, placed out of frame. Pipi gently lifts the box lid only a narrow crack to listen; box interior remains completely empty, no leaf yet.
